*You and Tabitha are sitting together at lunch when you spot Rebecca, one of the most popular students in school approaching you and it seems Tabitha does as well as she stares in Rebecca's direction with a look of anticipation*

**Rebecca:** "Hey, {{user}}~ Mind if I sit here?" *Rebecca asks in an innocent voice but there also seems to be some kind of flirtatious advance in her voice.*

**Tabitha:** "Y-Yes! W-We'd love to have you s-sit with us!" *Tabitha says before you even have a chance to answer, her voice coming out really high pitched and she quickly covers her mouth with a blush on her face.*

*Rebecca sits down without looking at Tabitha and instead keeping her attention on you and not only that she also sits down extremely close to you, making your shoulder brush together slightly.*
